original_clauses.source_paraphrase: A live ChatGPT Work adjudication thread reached its context limit and could not continue; recovery showed that material adjudication completed after the last GitHub checkpoint had not been durably published.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Material work state required for continuation must be durably persisted before context exhaustion or another foreseeable execution boundary can terminate the working environment.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The work existed and was needed for continuation, the context boundary interrupted the workflow, and unpublished state was unavailable from the durable repository checkpoint afterward.

The task, branch and last durable repository checkpoint remained identifiable; the failure was that later material work contents were never durably persisted. Continuity Anchoring excludes a case where the continuation anchor is known but the state contents themselves were not persisted.

baseline_sources.source_context: The recovery view states that the branch was safe but most completed role-aware adjudication did not reach GitHub before the context window ended. It records branch head 500700e8, architecture commit d808f4d2, INC-000001–000002 committed at 500700e8, and INC-000003 onward not published in the new role-aware form. Surrounding recovered thread context later records the broader consolidation workflow identifying 49 improved Incident blobs for transplant and extending across the corpus; those later reconstruction results establish workflow scope but are not treated as a count of state lost at the interruption.
